links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT answers to genetic disorder questions, as rated by genetic experts
links.effect: ChatGPT answered 64.7% of the 68 genetic questions; limitations and inaccuracies noted, particularly in understanding human inheritance patterns.
links.quote: Here we show that ChatGPT answered 64.7% of the 68 genetic questions asked and was able to respond coherently to complex questions related to the three genes/conditions.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's capability to accurately answer patient-facing questions about genetic disorders based on expert review of generated responses without testing specific organizational deployment safeguards.
